acceptance_condition: training_seconds + evaluation_seconds + checkpoint_seconds + margin_included_seconds <=32400; hard total32530 remains unchanged. Otherwise prepare concrete budget reconciliation without formal launch.
evaluation_method: Use accepted D8 sampled repeat1 and repeat4 condition wall seconds per returned raw frame separately. For each controller project all3072 formal games to the declared18000-gameplay-frame cap plus conservative startup allowance from registered source, then sum. This caps survival-exposure growth in the forecast rather than assuming final survival matches starting420.
margin_method: Add20% to training plus capped-exposure evaluation estimate, in addition to240seconds for saving/bootstrap/analysis. Do not reduce the margin or change budget after seeing cost to force acceptance.
training_method: Use accepted whole qualification worker elapsed divided by sum of its two actual gameplay-frame totals; multiply by twice the unchanged formal per-arm gameplay target. This includes measured initialization, learning, startup, cleanup and seed-stream overhead rather than excluding fixed work. Also report per-arm resource-journal spans and observed optimizer-step variation.
